title: Buy 5 AI-Powered Momentum Stocks for September After a Strong August
author: Na
description: U.S. stock markets surged in August driven by renewed AI enthusiasm, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite advancing 2.6% and 3.9% respectively. Five AI infrastructure leaders—NVIDIA, Super Micro Computer, Semtech, SiTime, and Keysight Technologies—all holding Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) ratings with momentum scores of A, are expected to maintain their upward trajectory. NVIDIA's data center revenue jumped 117% year-over-year to $89 billion, while Semtech projects 160% year-over-year data center growth in Q3.

title: Why SiTime Stock Blasted Almost 27% Higher on Thursday
author: Eric Volkman
description: SiTime surged nearly 27% after reporting strong Q2 earnings that more than doubled revenue to $157.4 million and quintupled adjusted net income to $2.34 per share, significantly beating analyst expectations. The company's communications, enterprise, and data center segment—driven by AI capacity buildouts—grew 181%, while other segments grew over 50%. SiTime also provided robust Q3 guidance of $285-295 million in revenue and $3.50-3.65 adjusted EPS, benefiting from organic growth and the recent Renesas timing products acquisition.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company delivered exceptional Q2 results with revenue more than doubling YoY, net income quintupling, and beating analyst estimates significantly. Strong Q3 guidance and dominant position in AI data center infrastructure provide positive momentum, though the article notes the stock is now expensive relative to valuations.
Renesas is mentioned only in context of its timing products division being acquired by SiTime. The acquisition is presented as a growth driver for SiTime but no direct impact on Renesas is discussed.

title: Questex’s Sensors Converge and Fierce Sensors Announce 2026 Best of Sensors Awards Finalists
author: Questex
description: Questex's Sensors Converge and Fierce Sensors announced the 2026 Best of Sensors Awards finalists, recognizing innovative technologies and companies shaping the future of sensing and electronics. The awards will be presented at Sensors Converge 2026, taking place May 5-7 at the Santa Clara Convention Center. Finalists span multiple categories including product innovation, MEMS solutions, IoT connectivity, and individual excellence awards.
